cutoff.admission_rule: Only the three listed full annual reports, each officially published strictly before the cutoff, are in the paired packet.

common_source_packet_release_rule: Release the same complete three-report local packet to both Baseline and Enhanced: the listed PDFs and their listed local text extractions only. Neither role may receive an added, substituted, withheld, or role-specific source file.

baseline.source_files: The same three listed report files and local text extractions.
baseline.permitted_tools: Local search and local text extraction only; no browser or external tools.

enhanced.source_files: The same three listed report files and local text extractions.
enhanced.permitted_tools: Local search and local text extraction only; no browser or external tools.

paired_allocation.equality_rule: Baseline and Enhanced have identical source files, tool access, and turn allocation: three report-reading turns plus one synthesis turn each.

role_firewall.packet_custodian: May retrieve only the three listed official CNINFO static PDFs, create their local text extractions, and record this receipt; must not interpret or summarize report content.
role_firewall.baseline_and_enhanced: May work only from the common released local packet under the identical allocation stated here; they may not browse, call external tools, or add sources.
role_firewall.outcome_access: No role receiving this packet may access FY2024 or post-cutoff metadata, report bodies, prices, returns, analyst material, subsequent events, or realized outcome material.
